✨ Join the Gorgeous Olivia Affiliate Program – Promote the #1 Best-Selling Glueless Lashes! ✨

About Our Brand & Products:

Gorgeous Olivia is a leading beauty brand specializing in revolutionary Self-Adhesive Cluster Eyelashes. Our glue-free, effortless, and natural-looking lashes have taken social media by storm, achieving the #1 best-selling spot in the beauty category on TikTok Shop with over 30,000+ monthly orders and a massive community of 6,000+ creators. Now, we are expanding our global footprint through our independent store, offering exclusive premium lash bundles and lash extension kits that beauty lovers adore.

What Makes Us Different:

Traditional lash glue causes allergies and messy applications. Our innovative self-adhesive technology allows users to apply flawless lashes in just 3 seconds—no glue, no mess, no damage to natural lashes. It’s high-quality, reusable, and perfect for beginners and makeup pros alike. 

How Affiliates Can Earn:

We highly value our creator community and offer one of the most competitive commission structures in the beauty industry:

• High Commission: Earn a generous 15% - 25% commission on every validated sale driven through your unique affiliate link or custom discount code.

• High Average Order Value (AOV): Our exclusive store bundles ($35 - $50+) mean bigger payouts for you per order compared to single-item marketplaces.

• Cookie Duration: 60 days. You get credited for any purchase made within 30 days of clicking your link.

How to Promote Us:

It's simple! Share your honest experience with Gorgeous Olivia. You can create Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or Pinterest Pins showcasing:

• 3-Second Application Tutorials

• Before & After dramatic eye-makeup transformations

• Aesthetic unboxing of our premium lash kits

• Tag us and include your affiliate link/code in your bio or video descriptions!

Other Information:

• Payout Schedule: Commission payments will be processed via bank transfer on the first and second of each month.

• Creator Support: Approved affiliates get access to high-converting creative banners, product videos, and priority communication with our manager. Top-performing creators will receive FREE product gifting for new launches!

Apply today and let’s grow together! If you have any questions, feel free to contact our affiliate team.(gorgeousolivia@outlook.com)
